description: Step 5 — Delete (DELETE /language-models/{modelName}): soft-delete (PENDING) -> Transcribe DeleteLanguageModel -> S3 training-data delete -> hard-delete metadata. Each step idempotent, bounded retry/backoff, re-runnable recovery (record stays PENDING on later-step failure so re-invocation resumes). Eligibility via Transcribe DescribeLanguageModel (reject IN_PROGRESS training) + ListTranscriptionJobs(Status=IN_PROGRESS) with GetTranscriptionJob fallback (authoritative, no DynamoDB in-use check). LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED audit. Least-privilege Lambda + route. Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-004.
steps: Add deleteModel(user, modelName) to <WT>/backend/src/services/language-model-service.ts: checkLanguageModelAccess (ownership) + requireRole(user,'TEAM_LEADER'). Eligibility: DescribeLanguageModelCommand -> reject (validationError) if ModelStatus==='IN_PROGRESS' (training). ListTranscriptionJobsCommand Status 'IN_PROGRESS' paginated via NextToken; for jobs whose summary lacks LanguageModelName call GetTranscriptionJobCommand to read Settings.LanguageModelName; reject if any in-progress job references this model (authoritative; do NOT consult DynamoDB for in-use). Deletion order, each idempotent, with bounded retry/backoff: (1) setDeletionStatus(modelName,'PENDING'); (2) DeleteLanguageModelCommand (already-absent/NotFound = success); (3) S3 DeleteObjectCommand on training-data/{modelName}/training.txt (already-absent = success); (4) hardDelete(modelName). On later-step failure leave the record PENDING and rethrow so a re-invoked DELETE resumes from the remaining steps (re-invocation on a PENDING record skips straight to Transcribe/S3/hard-delete). recordAuditLog LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED after success. Update language-model-service.test.ts.

Create <WT>/backend/src/handlers/delete-language-model.ts: JSDoc 'DELETE /language-models/{modelName}'; extractUser; modelName path param; call deleteModel; successResponse({ data: { deleted: true } }). Add delete-language-model.test.ts (eligibility rejection for training IN_PROGRESS and for in-progress job referencing the model; happy path; idempotent re-run).

Add property test 'Feature: language-model-team-isolation, Property N: delete order and idempotency' in language-model-service.property.test.ts: soft-delete always precedes Transcribe delete precedes S3 delete precedes hard-delete; re-invoking after a mid-sequence failure never repeats before the soft-delete and converges to hard-deleted without error when steps are already-absent. Docstring references the new delete requirement.

In <WT>/infra/lib/stacks/api-stack.ts add deleteLanguageModelFn = createLambda('DeleteLanguageModel', { entry: handlersDir, description: 'DELETE /language-models/{modelName} - Delete custom language model', environment: { ...commonEnv, ...transcribeEnv } }); grant DynamoDB read/write + KMS; grant S3 delete on ${dataBucket.bucketArn}/training-data/* (scoped s3:DeleteObject policy or grantS3ReadWrite); role.addToPolicy for transcribe:DeleteLanguageModel, transcribe:DescribeLanguageModel, transcribe:ListTranscriptionJobs, transcribe:GetTranscriptionJob; addRoute('DELETE','/language-models/{modelName}', deleteLanguageModelFn, jwtAuthorizer). Update api-stack snapshot.

findings: IMPLEMENTED delete (DELETE /language-models/{modelName}). SERVICE: new export deleteModel(user: AuthUser, modelName: string): Promise<void> in services/language-model-service.ts. Authorization: internal requireDeletableModel(user, modelName) loads getModel directly (NOT checkLanguageModelAccess — that helper 404s on PENDING and would block re-invocation resume); missing -> denyResourceAccess()/404; ADMIN any team; non-ADMIN must have model.teamId in getUserTeamIds else 404. Then requireRole(user,'TEAM_LEADER') (REVIEWER -> 403). ELIGIBILITY (only on FIRST pass, i.e. deletionStatus !== 'PENDING'; a PENDING record is mid-teardown and resumes WITHOUT re-running gates): (a) DescribeLanguageModelCommand -> reject validationError 400 when ModelStatus==='IN_PROGRESS' (an already-absent Transcribe model via isNotFoundError is tolerated, not training); (b) isModelInUseByInProgressJob(modelName) authoritative, NO DynamoDB in-use check: ListTranscriptionJobsCommand Status 'IN_PROGRESS' paginated via NextToken, reading summary.ModelSettings.LanguageModelName; when a summary lacks the name, GetTranscriptionJobCommand fallback reads job.ModelSettings.LanguageModelName ?? job.Settings.LanguageModelName; any in-progress job referencing the model -> reject validationError 400. DELETION ORDER (each step wrapped in withRetry: bounded retry DELETE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 with exponential backoff DELETE_BASE_BACKOFF_MS=50, overridable via new export setDeleteBackoffBaseMs for tests): (1) setDeletionStatus(modelName,'PENDING'); (2) DeleteLanguageModelCommand (isNotFoundError => treated as success/already-absent); (3) S3 DeleteObjectCommand Bucket=DATA_BUCKET_NAME Key=model.s3Key||training-data/{modelName}/training.txt (isNotFoundError => success; skipped if no bucket env); (4) hardDelete(modelName). RE-RUNNABLE RECOVERY: on a later-step failure the record is LEFT PENDING and the error is rethrown (no hardDelete, no audit); re-invoking the same DELETE finds deletionStatus==='PENDING', SKIPS the Describe/List eligibility gates, and resumes from the (idempotent) soft-delete through Transcribe/S3/hard-delete to convergence. recordAuditLog LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED (metadata { teamId, displayName }) only after a successful teardown. NEW EXPORTS: deleteModel, isNotFoundError(error) (NotFoundException/BadRequestException/ResourceNotFoundException/NoSuchKey name or Code/code NoSuchKey or http 404), setDeleteBackoffBaseMs(ms). NEW IMPORTS in service: DeleteLanguageModelCommand/ListTranscriptionJobsCommand/GetTranscriptionJobCommand (@aws-sdk/client-transcribe), DeleteObjectCommand (@aws-sdk/client-s3), denyResourceAccess (auth-middleware), setDeletionStatus+hardDelete (language-model-repository, already present from FEAT-001). HANDLER: new handlers/delete-language-model.ts (JSDoc 'DELETE /language-models/{modelName}', one handler per file, named export): extractUser; require modelName path param (400); call deleteModel; successResponse({ data: { deleted: true } }); inner try/catch rethrows AppError (has statusCode) else internalError('モデルの削除に失敗しました。'). TESTS: handlers/delete-language-model.test.ts (happy path + idempotent re-run both 200; missing param 400; training IN_PROGRESS 400; in-progress job 400; REVIEWER 403; not-visible 404; raw error 500). services/language-model-service.test.ts added deleteModel describe (REVIEWER 403 no teardown; not-visible 404; missing 404; training-IN_PROGRESS reject; in-use via summary ModelSettings reject; in-use via GetTranscriptionJob fallback reject; ListTranscriptionJobs NextToken pagination; ordered teardown soft->transcribe->s3->hard + audit; already-absent Transcribe+S3 => success; later-step persistent failure leaves PENDING + rethrows, no hardDelete/audit; PENDING resume skips eligibility gates). Added setDeletionStatus+hardDelete to the repo vi.mock and setDeleteBackoffBaseMs(0) in beforeEach. PROPERTY TEST (REQUIRED): services/language-model-service.property.test.ts 'Feature: language-model-team-isolation, Property 6: delete order and idempotency' (fast-check numRuns 100, docstring references the new delete requirement): test 1 proves soft-delete is always first, the deduped milestone order is soft->transcribe->s3->hard, firstSoft<firstTranscribe<firstS3<firstHard, and convergence (hardDelete + LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED audit) across failPoint (transient single-attempt failures absorbed by withRetry) x absence (already-absent) combinations; test 2 proves re-invocation after a persistent mid-sequence failure (transcribe/s3/hard) resumes from a PENDING record, never runs the Describe/List eligibility gates on resume, never runs a teardown step before the soft-delete, and converges to hard-deleted + audit. Extended the property-test repo mock with getModel/setDeletionStatus/hardDelete and imported recordAuditLog as mockedRecordAuditLog. LEAST-PRIVILEGE: grantDynamoDbReadWrite + grantKmsAccess; a scoped s3:DeleteObject PolicyStatement on `${props.dataBucket.bucketArn}/training-data/*` (NOT grantS3ReadWrite); a Transcribe PolicyStatement with exactly transcribe:DeleteLanguageModel/DescribeLanguageModel/ListTranscriptionJobs/GetTranscriptionJob (resources '*'). addRoute('DELETE','/language-models/{modelName}', deleteLanguageModelFn, jwtAuthorizer) after the PATCH .../team route.
